messages.text: Hello. Looking to buy 4 x Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s). Please can i ask the most up to date dispatch date for these units if i order and if your shipping costs include custom charges being paid for shipments into the UK? Lastly, do you have any live discount codes at the moment? Thank you for your time, Phil
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Hi Phil. The T. P2 ships October 3, 2026, so four units would go out on that date.

For the UK, no, shipping does not cover customs. Prices are USD and exclude VAT, so UK VAT and any import duty are charged on delivery by the carrier and are the recipient's responsibility. Shipping itself is calculated at checkout from your address.

On discounts, it's on sale now at $369 each, down from $449, and that price replaces a code rather than stacking with one.

Want me to build a cart for four?
Ok thank you for the info. Does it come with a UK plug/power supply.

It ships with a power supply and cord, but the only plug option on the listing is "US / EU (matched to your address)", so I don't want to promise you a UK plug off that. Let me get that confirmed properly rather than guess.
Handed to the team · Plug/voltage spec for UK delivery is not in the product data; only a US/EU varia

I've pinged the team, so stay in this chat and one of them will jump in with the exact plug and voltage spec for a UK address. If you step away, the answer comes to you by email.

What's the best email for you, Phil?
ok, if you can get me those details as that may now cost more overall from other sellers who include the UK plug with the unit.

Understood, and that's fair. The team's got it and will come back with the plug and voltage detail for a UK address.

Worth noting on the maths: at $369 each, four is $1,476 before shipping and UK VAT, and the power supply and cord are in the box either way. So the question is the plug end, which is a cheap part to solve, not the PSU.

Drop me an email address and I'll make sure the answer reaches you.

Got it, thanks Phil. That's on the ticket now, so the plug and voltage answer reaches you there as well as here.

Anything else you want checked while you wait? I can hold off on the cart until you've got the plug answer, or set up the four units now so you're in for the October 3 dispatch.
do you think you may have any black friday deals on these units.

I can't promise one, nothing's announced, and I won't have you wait on a maybe.

Two things worth weighing. The P2 is already discounted at $369 from $449, so it's on a deal now. And Black Friday lands well after the October 3 dispatch, so holding out would likely mean a later batch rather than the same units cheaper.

If a better price does land before they ship, tell me and I'll get it looked at for you.
With the Harlo OS installed on the P2, Can you schudule the P2 to work at certain times of the day at low model and then other times, for example 1am - 5am at medium or high mode?

Honest answer, I don't want to guess at that. Harlo OS does have power modes, but whether you can schedule them by time of day, say low through the day and high from 1am to 5am, is a firmware detail I'd rather have confirmed than assume.
Handed to the team · Harlo OS scheduling cap···· not in the product data.
That's gone to the team with your plug question, so both get answered together. Stay in the chat if you can, and either way it reaches your email.
please email the answer to (email hidden)

Will do, Phil. That address is on the ticket, so both answers, the UK plug and voltage, and the Harlo OS scheduling, come to (email hidden) A copy of this whole conversation lands there too once we're done here, and you can reply straight to it to reach us again.
